page-dashboard.png: Shell: v3 navigation (Overview, Backups, Alerts, Activity, Logs; no Config) and the user box. Overview shows Recent jobs and Storage pools, conditions with "since", and next steps by operation instead of script command lines. Mock data differs (64 GiB hosts, one staging VM).
page-hosts.png: Shell as on page-dashboard. Hosts show freshness, the duty host and the host answering instead of the control node and probe.
page-storage.png: Shell as on page-dashboard. Storage comes from the storage snapshot: freshness, scrub results, and LUKS mirrors by serial; disk operations arrive natively in M8, so v2's disk tiles are gone.
page-production.png: Shell as on page-dashboard. Mock data differs (prod1 shop, prod2 blog with failing replication 102-1); next steps are operations.
page-staging.png: Shell as on page-dashboard. One staging VM in the mock; jump SSH moved to the Deployer (M6.9), so v2's "Set up SSH access" tile is gone.
page-qdevice.png: Shell as on page-dashboard. QDevice comes from the cluster snapshot; checking SSH from the workstation moved to the Deployer.
page-diagnostics.png: Shell as on page-dashboard. Reports are bmacd operations; v2's workstation-only reports are gone.
page-operations.png: v2's Operations page is v3's Activity: jobs held by bmacd (host, who started it) and the operations to start, with no script command lines.
page-config.png: v2's workstation config files are v3's Settings: cluster settings and host facts edited in the browser with revisions.
page-settings.png: v2's Settings (config files on this computer, workstation preflight) is gone: preflight moved to the Deployer. v3's Settings edits cluster settings and host facts, and lists host keys.
page-config-editor.png: v2's text editor for a config file is v3's settings form; shown here with one unsaved change.
menu-run-switcher.png: Shell as on page-dashboard. The menu lists jobs held by bmacd instead of v2's startup refreshes.
console-open.png: Shell as on page-dashboard. The console shows a job's events by operation, with no script command line or PID.
dialog-launch.png: Shell as on page-dashboard. Launch dialog for staging.add: no script path, and v3's mock has fewer staging tiles behind it.
dialog-launch-advanced.png: No v3 equivalent yet: none of the mock's operations has advanced parameters.
dialog-file-browser.png: No v3 equivalent: the web app can't browse the workstation's files.
dialog-launch-destructive.png: Shell as on page-dashboard. Destructive launch dialog for staging.remove, without a script path.
dialog-launch-read-only.png: Shell as on page-dashboard. Read-only launch dialog for diagnostics.host_state, without a script path.
run-running-read-only.png: Shell as on page-dashboard. Job panel shows the host badge and "by" user instead of the script command line.
run-running-read-only-console.png: As run-running-read-only, with the console showing the job's output.
run-succeeded-read-only.png: As run-running-read-only; the warning and next step name operations.
run-dry-run.png: Shell and job panel header as on run-running-read-only; mock plan targets differ.
request-input-select.png: Shell and job panel header as on run-running-read-only; mock guests differ.
request-input-select-default.png: Shell and job panel header as on run-running-read-only; the snapshot name differs.
request-input-group.png: Shell and job panel header as on run-running-read-only.
request-validation-error.png: Shell and job panel header as on run-running-read-only; the message names mox3.
request-plan-confirm.png: Shell and job panel header as on run-running-read-only.
run-running-progress.png: Shell and job panel header as on run-running-read-only.
run-running-no-cancel.png: Shell and job panel header as on run-running-read-only.
run-succeeded.png: Shell and job panel header as on run-running-read-only; v2's exit code isn't shown because jobs aren't processes to the user.

run-cancelled.png: Shell and job panel header as on run-running-read-only.

fresh-landing.png: v2's first launch on a workstation becomes the Deployer (M6) and setup mode (M7.1). Shown here: v3's Settings before the cluster settings are saved, with its banner.
fresh-page-dashboard.png: No v3 equivalent: the web app always runs on a cluster host; a host not yet in a cluster is in setup mode (M7.1).
